name: PartialOrder

source.code:
/-- A partial order is a reflexive, transitive, antisymmetric relation `≤`. -/
class PartialOrder (α : Type*) extends Preorder α where
  protected le_antisymm : ∀ a b : α, a ≤ b → b ≤ a → a = b
